Happy Birthday
Bhumi

To my bestie-cum-behen 🫶

✦ ✿ ✦

Janamdin ki bahut saari shubhkamnayein, Bhumi! 🎂🌸

Radha Rani ki kripa hamesha tum par bani rahe. Tumhari zindagi prem, sukoon, khushiyon aur khoobsurat yaadon se bhari rahe. 💗

Shri Krishna tumhe hamesha apna aashirwad dein, aur tumhari har achhi manokamna poori ho. 🦚✨

Hamesha khush rehna, muskurate rehna aur apne aas-paas bhi wahi khushi baantte rehna. 🌷

🌸 🪷 🌸

“Radha Rani ka aashirwad aur apno ka pyaar, dono hamesha tumhare saath rahein.”
